chapter: Sue and Patsy Howard in show business
title: The Show Boat revival with Paul Robeson
summary: Patsy and her mother worked in a Los Angeles Show Boat with Paul Robeson.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: You mentioned your mother in Show Boat.

I didn't have anything to do with that, just worked in it, you know, and Paul -- like they call it, light opera, Paul Robeson was in it and oh, I am trying to think of the woman that played - had the original lead, Julie, she was also in it. What was her name, mother?
In the stage play of "Show Boat," she was one of the original cast, she and Paul Robeson and she played the part of Julie, sang "Can't Help Loving that Man of Mine."
Oh, Paul Robeson did it here?

Oh, I'm trying to think. It was the Civic Light opera at that time. Mother, do you remember what theatre that was? I remember it wasn't the Manne(?) I can't remember what that was. No, it wasn't the Philharmonic. Now like "Porgy and Bess" was revived but it was the Houston Civic Light opera, and that's the way they did Show Boat here.
